title: D-024 C1: bounded subagent contracts + structural workload sizing
objective: Implement the two linked pre-spawn records: worker-facing assignment schema (IDs, exact change, role, permitted/prohibited areas, deliverable/return schema, acceptance criteria, checkpoints, honest-blocker reporting, extension protocol, handoff duties - never any numeric token quota, percentage, countdown, or conserve-tokens pressure) and controller-only supervision envelope (structural size class, graph neighborhood/ownership/write lease, startup overhead, resolved model/context, telemetry sources, private health bands, detectors, landing opportunities, extension criteria); the structural classifier (main-session / cohesive-subagent / oversized-split-at-seams / unknown-recon-first) using the existing graph and evidence; startup/read-in overhead measurement feeding sizing calibration; graph-based sizing and smallest-complete context-packet construction preserving existing packet tiers. Goldilocks rule: no micro-spawn churn, no mega-assignments, resume healthy subagents, fork only when parent context is clean and inheritance helps. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R101 (Phase C).
business_reason: D-024 sections 5.5, 6, 13, 15-C: workload-first packaging is the primary prevention mechanism; worker-visible quotas are prohibited.
outputs: assignment + supervision-envelope schemas and structural classifier under tools/agent_supervisor
